title: Classiq Partners with FreeYa Mind Campus to Launch Quantum Applications Hub in Romania - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Quantum software provider Classiq has entered into a strategic commercial agreement with FreeYa Mind Campus (by S.C. Extensive Network SRL) to establish an enterprise quantum software, education, and application development hub at the campus’s Quantum AI Center in Ia–i, Romania.

The collaboration integrates Classiq’s quantum software platform—featuring AI agent interfaces, the Qmod high-level modeling language, circuit synthesis, and hardware-aware execution engines—with the campus’s on-site hardware infrastructure, which includes an on-premises IBM Quantum System Two installation.

Under the agreement, Classiq will establish its regional Romania headquarters at FreeYa Mind Campus to support commercial and academic projects across Eastern Europe. The hub builds on Classiq’s recent European expansion, including its Naples quantum software hub partnership with TEA TEK and its Quantum-as-a-Service deployment in South Korea with QAI.
